claim_scope: Prospective Stage-2 fixed16 complete-macro-action reachability screen only; no policy fitting, policy effectiveness, confirmation, scale, test, or paper claim.
scientific_objective: Determine whether four fully specified macro-actions contain a per-row branch oracle capable of reaching at least 15/16 official exact matches and greater than 0.90 official slot micro-F1 before collecting propensity-logged discovery data for an open-source Vowpal Wabbit controller.

frozen_inputs.same_row_direct_comparator: Reuse the frozen G1 M0 final response by exact sample identity; make no new STOP_M0 contact.
frozen_inputs.construction_example_ground: Reuse the exact G7 V2 frozen construction-example ground and its 28 frozen family boundaries without editing G7 artifacts.
frozen_inputs.shared_observation: One frozen-core OBS response per row from the original complete-dialogue speech packet, shared byte-for-byte by the three agent branches.
frozen_inputs.shared_family_evidence: Twenty-eight frozen-core family EVIDENCE responses per row, one per frozen family against the same speech packet, shared byte-for-byte by the three agent branches.
frozen_inputs.evidence_normalization: Apply the frozen G7 strict-first normalization once. Seal the normalized all-tool sheet before deriving any branch-specific supply.
frozen_inputs.final_authority: Every branch final response is authored by the frozen Qwen3-Omni core and must use the unchanged official JSON-array surface. No controller, parser, filter, or verifier may synthesize or repair a final answer.

macro_actions.definition: Return the sealed same-row G1 M0 final response by exact identity filtering.
macro_actions.final_author: frozen core in the sealed G1 M0 run

macro_actions.definition: Resolve once from the original speech packet, shared OBS, complete frozen all-tool execution sheet, and all 28 normalized family assessments exactly as in G7 V2.

Deterministically retain only registered tools whose normalized family status is exactly support, in frozen registry order, preserve their sealed evidence references and exact execution-sheet entries, remove every contradict and uncertain candidate, and resolve once from that supply plus the original speech packet and shared OBS.
macro_actions.empty_support_behavior: Pass an explicit empty support-only sheet to the resolver; do not add a fallback, infer a tool, or reuse an exhaustive candidate.

macro_actions.definition: Use three frozen-core contacts to decompose USE without changing the shared OBS or 28-family evidence: select exact registered tool names and call order, bind arguments for only those sealed selections, then author the official final response.
macro_actions.selection_scope: The speech-carrying selection contact receives the original dialogue, shared OBS, family objectives and operations, and the complete normalized tool-status surface without argument schemas. It returns only an ordered JSON list of exact registered tool names, may preserve repeated calls, and may not emit arguments or answer the task.
macro_actions.binding_scope: The speech-carrying binding contact receives the original dialogue, shared OBS, the sealed ordered tool selection, and only those tools' legal key skeletons and types. It returns one ordered argument object per selected call and may not add, remove, rename, reorder, or answer a tool call.
macro_actions.resolve_scope: The speech-carrying final contact receives the original dialogue, shared OBS, sealed tool selection, and sealed typed bindings. It remains the only new contact in this branch authorized to emit the official tool-call JSON array.
macro_actions.empty_selection_behavior: An empty sealed selection stays empty through binding and final resolve; no fallback, inference, repair, or exhaustive candidate is added.

decomposed_response_contract.duplicates: Preserve every repeated exact registered name in order.
decomposed_response_contract.binding_alignment: Require exactly one typed binding object per sealed selection occurrence, with identical name, count, and order.
decomposed_response_contract.invalid_stage_behavior: Abort and terminalize the one-shot attempt before the next contact; do not retry, repair, substitute an empty answer, emit branch manifests, or score.

prompt_fit.measurement_rule: Render and measure the actual serialized request, speech reserve, special-token reserve, and declared completion reserve immediately before every model contact. Never extrapolate later loop requests from an earlier fixed estimate.
prompt_fit.overflow_policy: Refuse before contact; never trim, lower a completion reserve, silently truncate, or move a sample across slots.

contact_budget.audio_seconds_rule: Compute and bind the exact repeated-speech reservation from the selected rows before any future execution authorization; this preregistration does not read audio or authorize contact.

sealing_and_scoring.gold_open_rule: Keep gold, reference transcripts, scorer outputs, and all evaluation annotations closed until all four complete 16-row branch manifests, traces, final responses, and costs are sealed.
sealing_and_scoring.manifest_rule: Run one official scorer process on each complete branch manifest. Never shard a manifest or average partial scorer results.
sealing_and_scoring.outer_parallelism: Independent complete branch manifests may be scored in parallel by an outer coordinator after the common gold-open condition is satisfied.
sealing_and_scoring.score_invocation_limit: Exactly one official scoring invocation per complete branch manifest.
sealing_and_scoring.per_sample_capture: Persist aggregate and per-sample scorer output from that same invocation; never rerun a branch scorer to recover row detail.

post_score_branch_oracle.per_row_selection: For each row, choose a branch with official exact match if one exists; among tied exact branches choose the highest row-level slot F1, then tool correctness, then the frozen branch order. If no branch is exact, choose the highest row-level slot F1, then tool correctness, then the frozen branch order.
post_score_branch_oracle.aggregate_metrics: Construct the 16-row oracle manifest from the selected sealed branch responses and compute unchanged official exact match, tool accuracy, and slot micro-F1 once.
post_score_branch_oracle.interpretation: This is a gold-informed action-set ceiling only. It is not a deployable policy, training result, or unbiased policy estimate.

promotion_rule.pass: Only if the post-score branch oracle reaches at least 15/16 exact and slot micro-F1 greater than 0.90 may a separately preregistered approximately 100-row randomized, propensity-logged discovery experiment fit a pinned Vowpal Wabbit controller.
promotion_rule.failure: If either oracle condition fails, do not fit a policy over these actions and do not proceed to the approximately 100-row Vowpal Wabbit experiment. Improve the knowledge or action set on a new identity-only discovery roster.
promotion_rule.baseline_admission_note: The greater-than-0.90 objective is a post-training-free-control target, not an admission requirement for the engineering baseline.

prohibitions: This preregistration and identity receipt do not authorize model, scorer, service, tokenizer, network, audio, gold, reference transcript, task-text, output, score, reward, test, or future-turn contact.
Do not fit Vowpal Wabbit, MABWiser, or any repository-specific policy on this fixed16 screen.
Do not change G7 artifacts, infer unobserved counterfactuals, synthesize a final answer, repair a branch output, retry, resend, prune after scoring, or tune on test data.
Do not proceed to approximately 100 randomized rows unless both frozen oracle thresholds pass.
